object: ci: playwright suite exists but no workflow runs it
why: The CI workflow was built to gate lint, types, unit tests and build, and the browser suite was left out rather than shipped half-working — it needs a running stack and a decision about which environment it points at.
cost_if_forgotten: The end-to-end tests rot. Nobody runs them, they drift from the app, and the day someone needs them they no longer pass for reasons unrelated to the bug being chased — at which point they get deleted instead of fixed.
revisit_if: ANY of: a regression reaches production that a browser test would have caught; the Playwright suite fails to run locally when someone next tries it; or 2026-10-16 passes with this still open.
